evidence_stages.SOURCE_LANDED: Private-source locator and byte-hash readback; no acceptance or authority
evidence_stages.R1_VERIFIED: Reversible typed parse with loss ledger, original variants and source-snapshot hash checks
evidence_stages.R2_QUALIFIED: Typed scoped relations, rights/ACL, ownership and independently reviewed provenance
evidence_stages.NATIVE_ADMITTED: Current signed RootAuthority, issuer/revocation, scoped lease, DBR and native readback
evidence_stages.LIVE_VERIFIED: Authenticated runtime/consumer and relevant non-loopback multi-node readback
evidence_stages.OWNER_ACCEPTED: Actual recorded independent owner acceptance of the scoped object and native evidence
evidence_stages.R3_VIEW_VERIFIED: Independent permissioned view test and negative privacy checks; orthogonal to native admission

source_review_exception.condition: Nonoperational, ACL-scoped derived review only; never grants native or owner state
